commonPrerequisites: Reviewed durable engine and isolation semantics; the memory double supplies neither.
Independently reviewed adapter/runner full commits, contract hashes and exact private command bytes.
Privately verified existing resource, namespace/run/ledger/window/fence, schema/index and unused run identity.
Trusted clock, stop/cancellation owner, original window and shared operation/attempt budgets.
Accepted enforceable all-in cost cap, prices and retained obligations.
Independent evidence authenticity, exact receipt byte digest, accepted restricted/sanitized custody and human one-run approval.

requirements.requiredEvidence: Independent engine transaction receipt binding the complete authority read set (including absent rows), before/after revision, exact command, attempts, both leases, full hold and terminal outcome.
Independent two-client transaction history proving stale ledger, scope, schema and authority-only snapshots conflict without partial writes or reset revisions.
Trusted-clock and attempt receipts proving fresh reads per explicit conflict, 100/250 ms backoff, three-attempt and 5000 ms limits within shared row/global budgets.
Engine/index receipt binding original window, four-field identity, attempt key and fence inside the transaction, with namespace/resource isolation and cross-scope rejection.
Engine read-dependency evidence for exact login, upload session, membership, permission and authority revisions, including missing-row and revocation conflicts.
Atomic integer microdollar accounting and retained-hold receipts plus separate accepted pricing and externally enforceable all-in cap; application counters alone are insufficient.
Independent commit evidence recovered only by original selector/command with fresh authority and shared read budget; unknown acknowledgement retains both leases and full hold.
Current generation-CAS claim, bounded expiry and accepted custodian receipts; independently verified original terminal receipt, integer cost and identical-receipt idempotent settlement.
Persisted original-scope cursor and immutable high-water evidence across two client restarts, bounded pages/passes, poison rows and repeat sweeps without starvation.
Compatible schema/fence baseline and retained-state custody evidence. Actual backup/restore and store restart require separate approval and are excluded from this run.
Separate reviewed rollover protocol and operation-specific approval proving old selector history and unresolved obligations survive; no rollover is authorized by the current run.
Reviewed non-production no-body pre/post denial receipts bound to exact source and destination, proving zero downstream effects without uploading a body.
